answer.reason: The keys of STAGES are exactly the six JobState values of wordmarket-sdk, matched one for one, and the doc comment calls them "marketplace job state[s]". The core looks them up directly from the vendor text (STAGES[s.stateCode]). The domain's own vocabulary is the coarser set of values (FINDING_TRANSLATOR, IN_TRANSLATION, and so on), not these keys, and no domain text names the key distinctions.
